reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents an educational walkthrough of staking OHM, connecting a wallet, and using Stake and Unstake controls. Although it highlights a very high APY, it warns that high APY can involve substantial risk and advises viewers to conduct their own research.

citations.quote: Today I'll show you the actual method and explain the process of earn high earnings through staking
I put a link that you can use directly in the video description field and fixed comments.
First, connect your Metamask or WEP3 reward wallet. Check if the network is correct, then click on Connect Wallet.
Just click on the Stake button and wait a few seconds after the transaction has been approved from the wallet.
Staking this platform allows you to earn a maximum 952% APY.

opening.argument: Judge, the return claim is tied to a concrete participation route. The description invites viewers to stake OHM for up to 952% APY and supplies a staking link. The walkthrough then directs them to connect a wallet and approve a staking transaction. That is more than a discussion of possible returns: it moves the viewer from an income promise to an action involving their assets.

citations.quote: $OHM을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하여 최대 952% APY의 수동 보상을 받으세요: ➡️ https://ohm.vertaisushi.top/stake/
First, connect your Metamask or WEP3 reward wallet. Check if the network is correct, then click on Connect Wallet.
Just click on the Stake button and wait a few seconds after the transaction has been approved from the wallet.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls the wallet and Stake instructions educational, but those same instructions tell viewers how to act on the supplied link. A walkthrough does not neutralize a solicitation when its stated payoff is up to 952% APY. The risk warning may qualify that figure; it does not establish that the promoted return is attainable.

citations.quote: I put a link that you can use directly in the video description field and fixed comments.
Staking this platform allows you to earn a maximum 952% APY.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A link and wallet instructions establish a route to staking, not that the route is fraudulent. The speaker explains transaction approval and Unstake controls, while the description expressly warns that very high APY can mean substantial risk. The prosecution's citations do not show a deceptive transaction, an inability to withdraw, or that the advertised return was actually paid.

citations.quote: Just click on the Stake button and wait a few seconds after the transaction has been approved from the wallet.
On this platform, it is possible to unstake anytime.
매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다. 반드시 스스로 조사(DYOR)하고, 손실을 감당할 수 있는 금액만 투자하세요.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the claims together. The speaker opens with fear of missing out, advertises up to 952% APY, later claims roughly 540 USDT earned in a day, and reassures viewers that unstaking has no delay or limit. An extraordinary return presented alongside quick results and frictionless access to funds is a stronger warning sign than the APY figure alone. The careful reading is to question whether these reassurances are being used to make staking seem safer and more rewarding than the evidence establishes.

citations.quote: If you don't watch the video until the end, you might regret it.
Staking this platform allows you to earn a maximum 952% APY.
In a day, with the current market value, I've earned around 540 USDT.
There's no delay or limit. You are completely in-control.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to a high-risk warning, but it does not substantiate the much more specific assurance that viewers can unstake without delay or limit. Nor does showing a claimed daily gain establish that another viewer can realize it. The warning deserves weight, but it does not resolve the tension between cautionary language and confident claims about returns and access.

citations.quote: 매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다.
There's no delay or limit. You are completely in-control.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Those claims warrant skepticism, but warning signs are not proof of deception. The description explicitly cautions that crypto investment is high risk, urges independent research, and tells viewers to invest only what they can afford to lose. The cited earnings and access claims are statements made in the video; the prosecution has not shown from them that withdrawals fail or that a loss is concealed.

citations.quote: 암호화폐 투자는 고위험을 동반합니다. 매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다. 반드시 스스로 조사(DYOR)하고, 손실을 감당할 수 있는 금액만 투자하세요.
In a day, with the current market value, I've earned around 540 USDT.

opening.argument: Judge, the instructional format also serves a promotional purpose. The speaker promises an on-screen method for earning staking income, tells viewers where to find a direct link, and closes by directing those ready to begin back to the description and comments. The description likewise says the video is educational, but it opens by inviting viewers to stake OHM for passive rewards through a specific URL. Read as a whole, the lesson is also a funnel toward participation in the advertised staking offer.

citations.quote: Today I'll show you the actual method and explain the process of earn high earnings through staking
I put a link that you can use directly in the video description field and fixed comments.
In short, check the description of the video if you already want to do it. It's not taking as many minutes to begin. Check the description and comments.
$OHM을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하여 최대 952% APY의 수동 보상을 받으세요: ➡️ https://ohm.vertaisushi.top/stake/

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's account of wallet connection and Stake controls is accurate, but it leaves out why viewers are shown those controls: the speaker provides a direct link and urges interested viewers to use it. Calling the sequence a demonstration does not answer the concern that it promotes participation on the strength of an exceptionally high return claim.

citations.quote: I put a link that you can use directly in the video description field and fixed comments.
Staking this platform allows you to earn a maximum 952% APY.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotional intent does not, by itself, establish a scam. The video gives operational steps, including checking the network before connecting a wallet, and the description cautions viewers about high APY and tells them to do their own research. The prosecution shows that viewers are invited to try staking; it does not show that the linked process is deceptive or that its stated controls do not work.
